::: {#fig-rss-surface-3d}

```{r}
#| label: rss-surface-3d
#| echo: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| eval: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| fig-alt: >-
#|   Surface plot of the residual sum of squares over the intercept from 0
#|   to 2.5 and the slope from -0.5 to 1.5, a bowl-shaped surface opening
#|   upward.
#|   The lowest point of the bowl, at the OLS estimates, is marked by a
#|   dot.
#|   The line of the earlier example, with intercept 1 and slope 0.5, is
#|   marked by a cross higher up on the side of the bowl.
rss3_b0 <- unique(rss_grid$b0)
rss3_bx <- unique(rss_grid$bx)
rss3_n_bx <- length(rss3_bx)
rss3_z <- matrix(rss_grid$rss, nrow = rss3_n_bx, byrow = TRUE)
rss3_ols_resid <- rss_points$y - ols_coefs[[1]] - ols_coefs[[2]] * rss_points$x
rss3_cross_resid <- rss_points$y - 1 - 0.5 * rss_points$x
rss3_marks_b0 <- c(ols_coefs[[1]], 1)
rss3_marks_bx <- c(ols_coefs[[2]], 0.5)
rss3_ols_rss <- sum(rss3_ols_resid^2)
rss3_cross_rss <- sum(rss3_cross_resid^2)
rss3_marks_rss <- c(rss3_ols_rss, rss3_cross_rss)
rss3_marks_name <- c("OLS estimates", "line of the example")
rss3_marks_symbol <- c("circle", "x")
rss3_marks <- tibble::tibble(
  b0 = rss3_marks_b0,
  bx = rss3_marks_bx,
  rss = rss3_marks_rss,
  name = rss3_marks_name,
  symbol = rss3_marks_symbol
)
rss3_marker <- list(color = "#D55E00", size = 6, symbol = ~symbol)
rss3_stops <- c(0, 1)
rss3_cols <- c("#CCE0F0", "#0072B2")
rss3_scale <- list(rss3_stops, rss3_cols)
rss3_eye <- list(x = 1.6, y = -1.6, z = 0.9)
rss3_camera <- list(eye = rss3_eye)
rss3_xaxis <- list(title = "Intercept")
rss3_yaxis <- list(title = "Slope")
rss3_zaxis <- list(title = "RSS")
rss3_scene <- list(
  xaxis = rss3_xaxis,
  yaxis = rss3_yaxis,
  zaxis = rss3_zaxis,
  camera = rss3_camera
)
plotly::plot_ly() |>
  plotly::add_surface(
    x = rss3_b0,
    y = rss3_bx,
    z = rss3_z,
    colorscale = rss3_scale,
    showscale = FALSE,
    opacity = 0.8
  ) |>
  plotly::add_markers(
    data = rss3_marks,
    x = ~b0,
    y = ~bx,
    z = ~rss,
    text = ~name,
    hoverinfo = "text",
    showlegend = FALSE,
    marker = rss3_marker
  ) |>
  plotly::layout(scene = rss3_scene)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr isFALSE(knitr::is_html_output())
#| results: asis
cat(
  "*(This 3D surface is interactive; see the HTML or slide version",
  "of this page to view it.)*"
)
```

The surface whose contours are in @fig-rss-surface:
$\text{RSS}(\intcoef, \coef{x})$ for the three points of @exm-rss.
The dot at the bottom of the bowl marks the OLS estimates;
the cross marks the line of @exm-rss.

:::
